requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/parsekv.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/parsekv_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func ParseKV(s string) (map[string]string, error)`. Parse "key=value" pairs separated by semicolons, trimming spaces around keys and values (e.g. "a=1; b=2"). An empty string returns an empty, non-nil map. A non-empty item without "=" or with an empty key returns a non-nil error. If a key repeats, the last value wins.
